title: Budapest FIR combined: heavy traffic, every kind of event
objective: Work all of Budapest ACC as one sector with heavy traffic and overlapping events. Priorities first: emergencies and STCA before routine.
challenges: All four sectors combined: long routes and many entry points
Overlapping weather, radio failure, TSA and emergency
criteria: No loss of separation (5 NM / 1000 ft)
Emergency acknowledged within 30 s, no STCA in its descent
No aircraft inside the TSA at FL195+ once it is active
Every request and coordination answered within 60 s

injects.text: A CB cell builds on a main flow.
injects.objective: Every deviation request answered before the aircraft deviates on its own (10 min)

injects.text: A neighbour asks for another exit level.
injects.objective: Answered within 60 s, and the aircraft leaves at the agreed level

injects.text: An aircraft stops answering and squawks 7600.
injects.objective: No aircraft within 5 NM / 1000 ft of the 7600 track while it is silent

injects.text: A TSA becomes active in five minutes, FL195 and above.
injects.objective: No aircraft inside the active area at FL195+ (10 min after activation)

injects.text: Pressurisation failure. Emergency descent to FL100, squawk 7700.
injects.objective: Acknowledged within 30 s, and no STCA with it in the descent to FL100

injects.text: An inbound flight arrives without transfer.
injects.objective: Assumed within 30 s of its first call

injects.text: An aircraft passes its cleared level.
